predictions: Ok, 18-6 is a pretty solid week (with the one additional match dropped to another forfeit). The interesting thing about the six I got wrong is that while there were the usual three matches that could have flipped on a single dart, the other three… I got very very wrong. No one-wire flip was saving me on those. Yikes. I miss lots of picks, but not usually the ones with big margins of victory. Just goes to show how volatile this game we play really is. And I mean both darts and predicting!

Match of the week: (A Div.) Brave the Elements @ Lunatic Fringe. The league's top billing here in week 7 is once again a matchup of undefeateds goliaths in A division. The RDL's top spot is the prize, and the winner sits alone. Been a little bumpier path for Fringe, but I expect they will have a full lineup for this one. Still, Element, 14-10.

Match #2: (B Div.) Darty Minds @ Consistently Inconsistent. This was supposed to be a battle of unbeaten titans, but Inconsistent had to go and drop that tiebreaker in week 3. Now it's still a huge matchup, just not quite that double-undefeated level. It's a better story for the race if Inconsistent wins, obviously. But I'm taking Darty Minds, 14-10.

Match #3: (G Div.) Heart of Dartness @ I Got Your 6. Oh, the G race is all kinds of hot, with the top four teams separated only by points. This pairing is tonight's only one pitting two of those 4-2 leaders against each other, and it includes the current top dog. I Got Your 6 just disposed of the Knights, and I'm taking them again here, 13-11.

Match #4: (D Div.) Menace 2 Sobriety @ Wing & A Plaque. Wing sits undefeated and they're just holding court at the top of the D standings. But while Menace is only at 0.500, the fact remains that they have just annihilated back-to-back opponents and have found something they didn't have early on. This is still Wing though, 14-10.

Match #5: (E Div.) Runs with Corks @ Death Throw. Death Throw just got dropped to the rung behind the Corkers, but this pairing still remains as two of the top three in E (and with Dirty Darts running away and hiding, this pairing could be the most important match left in E this season). I'm feeling a little upset-y here, and I'll take DT, 13-11.

Matches #6 & #7: (A Div.) Show Me Your Tips @ Dart Attack; Why So Serious? @ Talladega Flights. Ok, after six weeks of play, there is a block of four A teams with the same record in the chase for a spot among the league's top three squads! And here they all play each other! I'm guessing Dart Attack upends Show Me in a super tight 13-11; and Talladega restakes their top three claim, 15-9.

Match #8: (F Div.) Armed & Hammered @ Bottoms Up. Yep, Armed is still two matches off the F lead. But also yep, Armed is the team that just roasted the Ducks. I'm thinking that Bottom avoids that same fate, but this is going to be tight. Bottoms Up in 1001.

Matches #9 & #10: (C Div.) Village Idiots @ Darty Sanchez; The Outlaws @ Nine Lives. At first glance, this looks like two division leaders facing opponents with losing records. But if you look more closely, you'll see that the point differences aren't that large, and if there are two upsets here (if they are really even upsets), then five teams are within one of the lead in C at the end of the night. Sadly, I think the leaders take both here and quell some of the drama and excitement. Idiots outlast Sanchez, 13-11; and it's Outlaws, 14-10.

Match #11: (G Div.) The Dartifacts @ 21 Dart Salute. This isn't quite a matchup within the four G leaders, but it's pretty close, as Salute sits just one win and a few points back of the lead quartet. I get all Dartifacts picks wrong, so let's doom them. 14-10, 'Facts.

Match #12: (G Div.) We're Sexy & We Throw It @ Bright side of Flights. As predicted, Bright side's first ever win became their first ever win streak. Do we dare say the streak hits three? Sure! 13-11.
And the remaining 13 matches, sorted by division:
B Division: In The Hall 13, Raging 11; Hump Day 15, McGavin 9.
C Division: Off Constantly-Reboot 14, One Armed Bandits 10.
D Division: Rif Raf 14, Red-eye Rangers 10; Dart Side of the Moon 13, Ton 80 Proof 11; Liquor Possee 13, Irish Ton 11.
E Division: Cheap Shots 13, Sharky's Machine 11; Dirty Darts 16, Bangin The Wire 8; Rippin Darts 16, She-nanigans 8.
F Division: Duck Duck Groove 15, Nein Mark 9; Shark Shooters 13, Sofa Kings 11; That's What She Said 16, Coach's Into Enya 8.
